_comment: Feed registry for rss_discovery.py. Updated 2026-10-20: FeedBurner hosts (feeds.feedburner.com) are DNS-unreachable from the hunt sandbox, so THN moved to its origin news-sitemap, ESET to its origin RSS, and Google TI/Mandiant to an html-index scrape of the GTIG topic page (its RSS endpoint renders a JS shell). Added 9 origin-served vendor/CERT feeds verified fetchable on 2026-10-20. Known-blocked (HTTP 403 to the sandbox UA): CISA all.xml, Trend Micro, Huntress, Silent Push, HarfangLab — covered by the WebSearch leg instead.
